Based on my analysis, the issue is that `pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed` no longer exists in pytorch_lightning 1.9.4 (which is pinned in `requirements_versions.txt`). The `rank_zero_only` function has been moved to `pytorch_lightning.utilities.rank_zero`.

The files within the codebase that import from the missing module are:

1. **`modules/models/diffusion/ddpm_edit.py`** — imports `from pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed import rank_zero_only` on line 22
2. **`extensions-builtin/LDSR/sd_hijack_ddpm_v1.py`** — imports `from pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed import rank_zero_only` on line 17

Additionally, the error propagates from the cloned external repository (`repositories/stable-diffusion-stability-ai/ldm/models/diffusion/ddpm.py`) which also has this import. Since that file is not part of the codebase, a compatibility shim needs to be added in **`webui.py`** (after importing `pytorch_lightning`) to create the missing `pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed` module, redirecting `rank_zero_only` to the new location — this ensures the cloned repo's import also succeeds.
